top_signal.title: Full-Stack Developer from India 🇮🇳 — Websites, Mobile Apps, SaaS & Custom Software | Worldwide Clients Welcome
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone! 👋   I'm a Full-Stack Developer based in India, currently accepting freelance projects from clients worldwide.    Looking for a developer to bring your idea to life? I can help.    Whether you're a startup founder, business owner, agency, or individual, I can develop a complete digital product based on your requirements.   💻  Services I Offer       Website Development:  Business websites, landing pages, portfolios, e-commerce websites, and web applications.    SaaS Development:  Complete SaaS platforms, MVPs, admin dashboards, subscription-based applications, and business management systems.    Mobile App Development:  Android and iOS applications using React Native and Expo.    Custom Software:  Internal tools, CRM systems, management portals, booking systems, and custom business applications.    Backend Development:  APIs, authentication, database design, integrations, and server-side functionality.    AI & Automation:  AI-powered features, third-party integrations, and business workflow automation.    Existing Projects:  Bug fixes, new features, redesigns, and ongoing development.     ⚙️  Technologies    React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, NestJS, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Prisma, React Native, Expo, and REST APIs.   I can discuss other technologies depending on your project's requirements.   🤝  Why Work With Me?      Direct communication with the developer.   Frontend, backend, database, and deployment support.   Clean, responsive, modern
